business_quality: עובדה: פלטפורמת workflow ארגונית מובילה (ITSM ומעבר), עלות מעבר גבוהה; RPO 29.0B$ (+21%), cRPO 13.2B$ (+21%).
growth: Fact: revenue 5.9B->13.3B (2021-2025). Q3 2026 (release 28.10.2026): revenue 4,106M (+20.5%), subscription 3,988M (+21%), cRPO 13.65B (+20.5%). Guidance RAISED: FY26 subscription 15.78-15.79B (+22.5%), FCF margin 36% (+100bp); Q4 cRPO cc +18.5%. Part of 2026 growth is acquired (Armis, Moveworks).
profitability: Fact: GAAP operating income Q3 2026 385M (9.5% margin) vs 572M (16.8%) a year earlier; Q2 2026 162M (4.1%). Drivers (release reconciliation, Q3): SBC 633M (vs 492M), amortization of purchased intangibles 198M (vs 33M), severance 87M (vs 24M), business-combination costs 35M (vs 19M). Non-GAAP op margin 32.5%. ROIC 8.6% (EDGAR TTM 6/2026).
fcf: Fact: Q3 2026 OCF 839M (vs 813M), non-GAAP FCF 822M (20% margin); 9M 2026 FCF 3.12B. SBC Q3 633M = 15.4% of revenue.
balance_sheet: Fact: 9M 2026 acquisitions 9.2B; goodwill 3.6B->10.0B and intangibles 1.1B->3.6B since YE2025. nd_ebitda ~1.1 (EDGAR TTM 6/2026) — passes.
capital_allocation: Fact: no buybacks in Q3 2026 (vs 584M); FY26 diluted shares guided 1.04B (~flat); sbc_rev TTM 14.8%, Q3 15.4%.
cyclicality: no — הכנסות מנויים חוזרות; אין רווח שיא מחזורי.
structural_risks: חשש ש-AI agentic יקטין מושבים/יחליף workflows (המניה -27% מהשיא ב-252 ימים); אינטגרציה של Armis; האטת צמיחה; SBC שעלול להכשיל גם את מבחן הדילול.
valuation: EXPENSIVE — close 109.65, P/E GAAP TTM 67.9, FCF yield TTM 4.04% (current_state 30.10); ~20% subscription growth and 36% FCF-margin guide do not make it UNJUSTIFIABLE.
red_flags: D2 triggered: GAAP operating income on the last 2 quarters -41%, margin -7.3pp (acquisition amortization, SBC, severance — none is a U2-recognised one-time item).
reason: New Q3 2026 report: GAAP operating income on the last two quarters fell 41% YoY (547M vs 930M) and margin fell 7.3pp, triggering D2 -> WATCH.

override_evidence: D2 (last 2 reported quarters Q2+Q3 2026 vs Q2+Q3 2025, combined, GAAP): revenue 8,093M vs 6,622M (+22.2%); operating income 547M (162+385) vs 930M (358+572) = -41.2% (threshold -20%); op margin 6.8% vs 14.0% = -7.3pp (threshold 5pp). U2-type adjustments: no litigation, impairment or acquired IPR&D in Q2/Q3 2026 (9M 2026 impairment = 0); 9M 2025 impairment 30M (not in Q3 2025; even adding it to Q2 2025: 547M vs 960M = -43%). Excluded items in the gap are amortization of purchased intangibles (198M vs 33M in Q3), SBC, severance and business-combination costs — not on the U2 list, so they stay. Sources: ServiceNow Q3 2026 release 28.10.2026 (reconciliation table); Q2 from EDGAR quarterly series (core/sec/NOW.json). D3: FCF positive all quarters, diluted shares ~flat — none. D4: guidance raised, not cut — none. D5: EXPENSIVE, not UNJUSTIFIABLE. The -30% price move by itself is not a reason.
